title: Tentacled Grin (Skull with tentacles)
notes: The most crucial drawing. It's the last drawing which I made as an artist, and after that I switched to programming. So, this was a wild era, and this did apex the overthinking which I started at 2018, I think. And the tentacles represent the brain and the overthinking which is slowly breaking down my skull. That's the representation of overthinking, how it felt when it was 2018. This is the topmost, it is one of the best pictures, and I want it to be in the featured.

title: Train Emerging From Tunnel
notes: It's like a black and white image, a train emerging from a tunnel. It feels like me getting out of depression and that's what it depicts. So, inside the tunnel, it's quite dark and the train is still muddy and old. It's still running and it's emerging now from the darkness to the bright outside to show what the power it has. That's when I started getting out of depression, not yet fully out. That's where I thought I am better than who I think I am.
